scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['apps/api/dist','apps/worker/dist','packages/application/dist','packages/config/dist','packages/core/dist','packages/domain/dist','packages/infra/dist','.turbo','coverage'].forEach(p => fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }));"
scripts.typecheck:native: node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --version && for p in packages/core packages/domain packages/config packages/infra packages/application apps/api apps/worker; do node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p $p/tsconfig.json || exit 1; done
